note: Reviewed decisions that two identities sharing one street address are distinct businesses. Without a record here an address collision blocks publication: the guard treats a shared address as UNREVIEWED, never as an automatic duplicate and never as an automatic pass. resolutions.evidence: The operator's own site publishes the two venues on separate pages: the DogHouse hotel at /pages/hotels-doghouse-columbus and the DogTap taproom at /pages/bars/dog-tap-columbus. The taproom has been published as a pet-friendly-restaurant since 2026-07-15 under source_type OFFICIAL_BREWERY; the hotel is promoted here as a separate lodging identity. One address, two businesses -- neither is a duplicate of the other and neither is merged or suppressed.
